property_summary: For any inputs, C always invokes the external function with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so a callee implementing that exact function will be called and succeed), whereas the mutant instead calls transfer(address,address,uint256) which will not match a callee that only implements transferFrom and thus can cause the low-level call to fail — so for some callee implementations the reference succeeds (returns true) but the mutant reverts or returns false.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector computation to use transfer(address,address,uint256) so different external function is invoked, altering caddress.call outcome and thus return behavior.
